correctness.rationale: On every nonconstant affine edge branch the arclength slope is at least sqrt(2); the original source supplies a finite edge partition and denseness of plateau preimages for all parameters. For the killed transfer operator K, a depth-r interval J contributes variation at most s_J^{-1}(3 Var_J(h)+2 |J|^{-1} integral_J |h|). Summing disjoint surviving branch domains gives Var(K^r h) <= 3 (sqrt(2))^{-r} Var(h)+C_r||h||_1. With r=4 the contraction coefficient is 3/4. L1 contractivity and BV compactness make the Cesaro limit of K^n 1 a nonzero stationary BV density if the survivor set has positive measure. An invariant density cannot charge any plateau preimage, but every nonzero positive BV density charges an open subinterval and therefore the dense open union of plateau preimages. Contradiction. Independent exact arithmetic verified all sixteen quadrant/direction matrix images and the coefficient 3/4. The global graph census/density are used as cited published premises, not established by this finite check.

value.rationale: Full graph-arclength absorption for every parameter was explicitly conjectural in the original all-parameter graph paper and established only in special parameter regions by the sequel. The new theorem proves that natural measure-theoretic question simultaneously for all real b by an honest general BV killed-transfer argument. This is a useful structural result despite employing familiar transfer-operator tools; no ambient planar area or exceptional-set dimension is claimed.
